condition:
recombinant WT R. rubrum encapsulin 
coexpressed with cognate EncFtn cargo in E. coli; EncFtn-loaded
source: He et al. 2016; McIver et al. 2026
notes:
Biologically relevant cognate EncFtn-loaded WT T=1 assembly. He et al. 2016 measured coexpressed EncFtn-Enc 
particles at 23.9 ± 2.2 nm by negative-stain TEM. McIver et al. 2026 resolved the loaded shell by cryo-EM and showed an icosahedral 60-subunit architecture with greater five-fold pore flexibility than the empty shell; cargo loading was heterogeneous, with up to five EncFtn decamers per cage. PDB 9RZM / EMD-54404 represents the loaded shell reconstruction, while PDB 9SQR / EMD-55116 is a symmetry-relaxed loaded nanocompartment containing the 60-subunit shell and resolved EncFtn cargo. Focused open/closed pentamer structures 9S05 and 9RZU are treated as pore conformations, not separate assemblies.
